findings.title: Uncapped liability for BAA breaches and data incidents
findings.deviation: The BAA explicitly carves out all BAA-related breaches and indemnification from any liability cap mentioned in the Master Services Agreement.
findings.impact: AtliQ faces unlimited financial exposure for any HIPAA violation, data breach, or BAA breach, contrary to the standard 1x fee cap.
findings.quote: The obligations of Business Associate under this Article 8 are not subject to any limitation or exclusion of liability, and shall apply notwithstanding any limitation of liability in the Master Services Agreement.
findings.counterPosition: All liability under the BAA, including for data incidents and indemnification, must be subject to a liability cap (ideally a 2x fees super-cap).

findings.title: One-way uncapped indemnity for data events
findings.deviation: AtliQ provides a one-way indemnity for any 'Privacy Event' or breach of the BAA, without any requirement for fault/negligence and without a cap.
findings.impact: AtliQ must pay for all losses (including regulatory fines and forensics) even if the event was not caused by AtliQ's negligence.
findings.quote: Business Associate shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Covered Entity... from and against any and all Losses arising out of or relating to (a) any Privacy Event involving Business Associate or any Subcontractor; (b) any breach of this BAA... or (c) any violation of HIPAA
findings.counterPosition: Indemnity should be mutual, limited to third-party claims caused by a party's own breach or negligence, and subject to the liability cap.

findings.title: Prohibition on offshore data access and personnel
findings.deviation: The BAA prohibits any access, processing, or storage of PHI from outside the United States and requires all subcontractor personnel to be US-based.
findings.impact: This prevents AtliQ's Pune entity from supporting the project or accessing the environment, which conflicts with AtliQ's standard global delivery model.
findings.quote: Business Associate shall not, and shall ensure that no Subcontractor shall, access, view, create, receive, maintain, transmit, store or process PHI from or at any location outside the United States... all of its personnel performing Services shall be located in the United States.
findings.counterPosition: Allow remote access from AtliQ's offshore delivery centers (including India) subject to agreed security controls and flow-down BAA terms.

findings.title: Cyber insurance limit exceeds current coverage
findings.deviation: The BAA requires $5,000,000 in cyber liability insurance, whereas AtliQ's current coverage is $1,000,000.
findings.impact: AtliQ is unable to meet this requirement without purchasing additional coverage at its own expense.
findings.quote: Business Associate shall maintain... cyber liability and network security and privacy insurance with limits of not less than Five Million U.S. Dollars ($5,000,000) per claim and in the aggregate
findings.counterPosition: Align the required insurance limits with AtliQ's actual current coverage ($1,000,000).

fine.note: Ownership of PHI and derived data by the client is standard in a healthcare context and does not misappropriate AtliQ background IP.
The 30-day data destruction window and termination for uncured breach are standard BAA provisions.
There are no liquidated damages or delay penalties included in this BAA.
No acceptance criteria are specified in this BAA, which is standard for a data protection exhibit.
Confidentiality obligations regarding PHI are appropriately defined in accordance with HIPAA regulations.
